title: Delannoy valuation laws: explicit thresholds and multiplicative differences
description:
Working preprint by César Augusto Grisa (Independent Researcher). This revision presents integrated arguments for the four Delannoy valuation conjectures formulated by Lengyel (2021), an explicit generic threshold, basepoint valuations, a two-point law on even indices of equal 2-adic valuation, and the consequence v2(D(pn)-D(n)) = v2(p-1)+3v2(n) for positive even n and odd p greater than one, without a primality assumption.

The manuscript includes AI-assisted proof suggestions and drafting, as disclosed in its assistance statement. It remains a working draft for author and specialist verification and has not been peer reviewed. The original finite NEG archive is preserved as supplementary data. Its internal consistency was checked; the missing term generator, decomposition definitions and tail arguments were not reconstructed. The NEG archive is not a premise of the universal proof.
